findings_addressed.finding: One randomly generated password cannot reliably show whether Exclude ambiguous changes the alphabet.
findings_addressed.correction: Added a deterministic PasswordGenerator component case. It holds external Web Crypto randomness to the same sample (1), disables every group except digits, and sets length 22. With Exclude ambiguous enabled, the real generator returns 22 threes; when disabled, it returns 22 ones. This forces the output through the real UI option and generator alphabet selection without relying on chance.
